summary: ConnectM Technology Solutions, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a definitive Share Swap Agreement dated April 6, 2026, whereby ConnectM and AstraBridge Inc. will transfer all shares of Global Impx Inc. (94.1% owned by ConnectM, 5.9% by AstraBridge) to Blue Cloud Softech Solutions Limited in exchange for 170 million equity shares of Blue Cloud (160 million to ConnectM, 10 million to AstraBridge). Post-closing, ConnectM will own ~17.33% of Blue Cloud. The Blue Cloud shares are subject to a six-month lockup. Closing is expected within 180 days of May 4, 2026, conditioned on Blue Cloud board and stockholder approval (obtained May 4, 2026), BSE Limited approval, and completion of documentation. Watch for regulatory clearance and BSE approval timeline.
